title: doratoxylon chouxii
intro: Doratoxylon chouxii, commonly known as the "Makabuhay" tree, is a plant species native to the Philippines. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and other ailments. The health benefits of Doratoxylon chouxii are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal value.
